name: hermes
description: Hybrid Engine for Research, Memory, Execution & Synthesis. Stages 0-5 built and unit-tested (144 tests, 2 env-conditional skips); Stage 0 proven end-to-end on real disk with a human-gated self-improvement loop; live-traffic proving of autonomy/external paths in progress: security-gated orchestration + memory/self-improvement (Apollo, Mnemos v2, Curator, ReasoningBank, Dream), autonomy (Cron durable scheduler, Delegation, Fetcher SAFE_MODE, Connect MCP+PKCE), hardening (Tier-3 guard, D1 approval tokens, think-scrubber, upstream tracker, repeatable 7-layer audit), and opt-in integrations (db, webdev, media, caveman, kanban, turbo memory, notebooklm, composio). NYX (Stage 6) deliberately out of scope.
author: Anubhav Mohandas
